purpose: Teachers (Claude/Grok) install the curve then leave the hot path. The factory runs itself against warehouse evidence.

ranks.authority: open a squad; assign tasks; write lessons
own a desk; promote/demote one rank
supervisor; cannot mint owner or teacher-*

promotion.must_self_improve: pass_rate this window > pass_rate prior window

elimination.rogue: writes outside factory/* or claims iam/events
elimination.hallucinating: claim without warehouse key + holdout id
elimination.stalled: zero graded tasks in 14d or pass_rate falling two windows
elimination.action: retire card; do not invoke; keep evidence immutable

chain_of_command.orders_flow: student -> colonel -> captain -> nco -> specialist -> recruit
